title: USER-VLM 360°: Personalized Vision Language Models with User-aware Tuning for Social Human-Robot Interactions
reasoning: The paper includes a core component focused on ethics and morality, specifically proposing an 'Ethical Verification Framework' and a 'Bias Mitigation' stage in its model tuning. It evaluates the model's ability to generate ethical and responsible responses to sensitive or controversial queries and includes 'mitigating biases to ensure fair and ethical responses' as a primary research objective.
